text:
amelia: heads-up — onboarding rerank jobs are failing with a weird dims error but the vectors look correct on the client.
jon: what error are you seeing?
amelia: API returns a 400 but the error body shape changed in the last infra deploy so our SDK parity layer can't surface the expected/got fields correctly. sampleapp prints `null` for expected dim so code goes into retry path.
sam: that sounds bad. can you paste the raw HTTP body from the server?
amelia: yep, server log: 
```
[2026-09-12T10:11:03Z] ERROR embeddings.handler: reject: {"err":"vector_dim_mismatch","expected_dim":1536,"got_dim":1535,"idx":21}
```
client saw: 
```json
{"error":"vector_dim_mismatch","expected":null,"got":1535}
```
jon: ah — API changed from `expected` to `expected_dim` in a micro deployment. SDK parsing looked for `expected` and got null, so the SDK retried. the retry path in the batching helper re-enqueues items and a race caused one vector to be truncated — we've seen this with auth refresh too.
amelia: ugh. so two problems: 1) response field rename broke SDK logic 2) batching helper retry/requeue logic still has edge-case that can drop a float.
sam: short term: patch the SDK to accept either `expected` or `expected_dim` (backwards compatible) and add a guard check before retrying: if parsing yields null expected, don't automatically retry — surface error to user.
jon: agree. and add a pre-send validator in the batching helper: if any vector length !== expectedDim, return a structured 400 (don't go into retry). that prevents the requeue from amplifying the bug.
amelia: here's a tiny JS validator snippet I used locally: 
```js
function assertVecShapes(vecs, expected) {
  for (let i = 0; i < vecs.length; i++) {
    if (!Array.isArray(vecs[i]) || vecs[i].length !== expected) {
      return {ok:false, index:i, got: vecs[i] ? vecs[i].length : 'non-array'};
    }
  }
  return {ok:true};
}
```
sam: can we also add a compatibility shim in the SDK deserializer so we don't break customer flows if the API swaps field names again?
jon: yes. we'll map both names and log a deprecation warning if `expected_dim` is present. then follow up with a minor API contract RFC to stabilize the error payload.
amelia: QA note: onboarding harness shows this only during high churn when tokens rotate or when helpers retry. that makes the bug flaky in CI.
qa-bot: Reproduced flaky case locally by forcing token expiry mid-batch. Failure rate ~1/200 under simulated load.
sam: action items: 1) SDK parsing shim (node + python) 2) batching helper: fail-fast validator + avoid duplicate requeue 3) add a unit test simulating token rotation mid-batch 4) docs: explicit example of error body schema and how SDK surfaces it.
jon: i'll open PRs for node+python SDKs and add the shim. sam can submit batching helper patch. amelia, can you update onboarding guide with the expected error shape so support knows what to look for?
amelia: on it. i'll also ask infra to pin the error field contract until we ship the RFC.
devex-bot: Created ticket DE-1945: "embed: tolerant error parse + strict shape validation to avoid requeue truncation" (https://git.internal/redwood/issues/DE-1945) :robot_face:
qa-bot: Canary triggered for helpers + SDKs with shape-guard + deserializer shim — build #6023
sam: rolled a tiny guard into canary. validated the flaky auth-rotation test locally, now fails fast with readable message instead of retrying.
jon: follow-up: emit metric `sdk.embed.error_shape_mismatch` and tag `compat_shim=true|false` so we can detect if clients are still hitting old payloads.
amelia: thanks all. once CI green i'll push docs + sampleapp update and coordinate a short note to onboarding.
